entries.zh: 反复；反复（对某人）纠缠事务、颠倒变更（反覆）
entries.en: to overturn or turn things over repeatedly; to reverse oneself, to be inconstant; to haggle back and forth over matters

entries.zh: 〔存疑〕（疑为）翻回、反转之义（词头「归返王所」类义项下所记单字「屏」，此条与第3条互参）
entries.en: doubtful: (per the Spanish sense of turning back/returning) a reversal or turning; character recorded as 屏, sense uncertain
entries.notes: T99 污损且汉字标注[疑]，与下条「boluer del reues」互参方能定位语义。

entries.zh: 颠倒回转；翻转过来（屏辇转：倒转）
entries.en: to turn upside down, to reverse, to turn over (from the reverse side); upside-down
entries.notes: 汉字「輦」标注[疑:輦/拼]，展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 翻转；颠倒覆回（屏覆）
entries.en: to turn over, to overturn, to flip back

entries.zh: 退还、退回（钱款）；归还所付之物
entries.en: to pay back, to refund, to return (payment or goods)

entries.zh: 退还官职；交还职务、卸任
entries.en: to give back an office, to resign or return one's post; to restore an office

entries.zh: 退还给人；归还（书信、字据等）给本人（退还人）
entries.en: to return to someone, to give back (letters, documents) to the person; to restore to its owner

entries.zh: 辞退、推辞；谢绝（所送之物或请托）（退辞）
entries.en: to decline, to refuse, to send back; to reject (an offer or gift)
entries.notes: M 栏 T99 污损；西语词头拼写含讹（lepan/precimidos），语义据退+辞推断。

entries.zh: 退后；往后退、却步（退后）
entries.en: to fall back, to retreat, to step backward

entries.zh: 运转；旋转、周而复始地转（运）
entries.en: to move round, to revolve, to turn round and round; to circulate

entries.zh: 运转；环绕旋转（运转）
entries.en: to revolve, to wheel round, to circle about
entries.notes: M 栏含西语旁注且 T99 污损，第二字释义存疑。

entries.zh: 旋转一周；转身环绕（旋）
entries.en: to turn round about, to whirl, to spin around
entries.notes: M 栏注 Goān、R 栏作 lîen，对音不一致；汉字与西语义项（转身边）为释义主据。

entries.zh: 回而有答；答复、回报（归着：回来带着回应）
entries.en: to come back with an answer, to return a reply; to answer in return

entries.zh: 复命；办毕公务回禀交差（复命）
entries.en: to report back on completion of a task, to render an account upon return (fu-ming)

entries.zh: 交还职任；任满交官还乡（交还任）
entries.en: to hand back one's office/post at the end of tenure; to return home when the term of office is over
entries.notes: 汉字「任」标注[疑:任/伍]，缩写 Off.º 展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 乡官；本乡本土的官吏（任满归乡语境下的「乡官」）
entries.en: a mandarin of one's native district; a local village official

entries.zh: 乡官；县里的官（乡官，M 栏注 mandarin del pueblo）
entries.en: the mandarin of the district/township; local magistrate of one's county

entries.zh: 乡村；乡里、村庄（M 栏注 aldea：村落、田庄）
entries.en: the countryside, a rural village; an aldea (hamlet, farmstead)

entries.zh: 复职；官复原职、重新任职（复职）
entries.en: to be restored to one's office, to resume a post; reinstatement

entries.zh: 还复；恢复、复原（还复：回复原状）
entries.en: to restore, to bring back, to recover; to return to a former state
entries.notes: 西语词头「Boluer el remo no –」拼写有讹、语义不明，据汉字还復与四栏对音释义。

entries.zh: 回赠、回送；答谢回礼（回送）
entries.en: to give back as a present, to make a return gift; to send back

entries.zh: 急转去；急急转身而去、迅速掉头离开
entries.en: to turn round quickly and go away, to hurry back off; (sense of departing in haste)
entries.notes: 原件此处涂改并有被删字迹，且 R 栏 T99 污损，语义据 M 栏对音推断。
